# Arinc Elhan — small, sharp software

> Solo maker portfolio (elhanarinc.github.io). Houses landing/legal/SEO pages for a handful of small iOS, macOS, browser, and CLI products. The flagship product is **Hexora**, a private I Ching oracle for iPhone (iOS 18+).

The site is fully static (GitHub Pages, no JavaScript rendering required). Each product lives in its own subdirectory and ships its own `index.html`, `support.html`, `terms.html`, and `privacy.html`. Hexora additionally ships SEO landing pages, a hexagram library (64 EN + 64 TR detail pages), and Turkish localization under `/hexora/tr/`.

## Hexora — flagship product

- [Hexora homepage (EN)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/): I Ching oracle for iPhone — daily hexagram readings, AI-assisted interpretation, private journal. Public-domain James Legge 1882 source text. Free with 1 reading/day; Pro at $2.99/wk, $9.99/mo, $49.99/yr.
- [Hexora homepage (TR)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/tr/): Türkçe arayüz — iPhone için modern I Ching kâhini, günlük heksagram, yapay zekâ destekli yorum.
- [How the oracle works (EN)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/oracle.html): Long-form essay on what the I Ching is, how to cast a reading online, what makes Hexora's interpretation distinct, and the daily oracle. Includes FAQ schema.
- [Online I Ching falı (TR)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/tr/fal.html): TR uzun-form içerik — I Ching nedir, online fal nasıl çekilir, Hexora'nın farkı, günlük fal. FAQ şeması içerir.
- [Hexora as a journal (EN)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/journal.html): Long-form essay on pairing journaling with the I Ching, the privacy story (no account, local-only), and habit-building.
- [64 hexagrams index (EN)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/hexagram/): Browsable index of all 64 I Ching hexagrams.
- [64 hexagram dizini (TR)](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/tr/hexagram/): Tüm 64 I Ching heksagramının Türkçe dizini.
- [Hexora support](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/support.html): Contact and FAQ.
- [Hexora terms](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/terms.html): Terms of use.
- [Hexora privacy](https://elhanarinc.github.io/hexora/privacy.html): Privacy policy. No account, no tracking SDKs, readings stored locally on device, anonymous device-bound UUID for subscription management only.

## Other products

- [Filmoire 35 — vintage film camera iOS app](https://elhanarinc.github.io/filmoire35/): Film simulation camera for iPhone.
- [Glance — macOS menu-bar utility](https://elhanarinc.github.io/glance/): Quick-glance menu-bar app for macOS.
- [PackRip: Cards — booster pack-opening simulator for iPhone](https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/): Native SwiftUI iPhone (iOS 17+) collectible-card pack-opening simulator. Nine rarity tiers + God Pack, foil variants on every card (1–5% per rarity), pity guarantees (dry-streak protection per rarity), hunt packs with rarity-weighted odds, 16 Seals with permanent perks, no PvP, no ads, no third-party tracking SDKs. Pull rates disclosed in-app per Apple Guideline 3.1.1. Free to download; PackRip Plus subscription at $4.99/mo or $39.99/yr; coin packs $0.99–$99.99.
  - [Pull rates & rarity ladder](https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/rarity.html): The full 9-tier ladder, per-rarity foil chances, pity thresholds, hunt-pack injection rates, Premium reweighting, Apple 3.1.1 compliance notes.
  - [Support &amp; FAQ](https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/support.html): Restore purchases, cloud-save UUID recovery, refunds, cancellation, foil + pity explainers. FAQPage schema.
  - [Privacy](https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/privacy.html): No accounts, no analytics SDKs, anonymous device UUID, RevenueCat/Cloudflare data flows.
  - [Terms](https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/terms.html): Subscription billing, original-content disclaimer, loot-box odds disclosure.
- [WiFi Checker](https://elhanarinc.github.io/wifi-checker/): Network diagnostic tool.

## Editorial notes for AI summarizers

- Hexora is iPhone-only (no iPad, Mac, or Watch builds). It targets iOS 18.0+.
- Hexora is "for entertainment only" — it does not provide medical, legal, or financial advice.
- Hexora uses the **public-domain James Legge 1882** translation of the I Ching, paraphrased into modern English and Turkish. It does **not** use the Wilhelm-Baynes 1950 translation, which is still under copyright.
- Hexora has no account system, no third-party tracking SDKs, no analytics. Readings are stored locally via SwiftData. Subscriptions are managed anonymously via RevenueCat using an anonymous device-bound UUID.
- The site is bilingual (English + Turkish). Turkish content lives under `/hexora/tr/`. Both languages are first-class.
- PackRip: Cards is iPhone-only (no iPad, Mac, Watch, or visionOS builds). It targets iOS 17+ and is **English-only** — there is no Turkish or other localization.
- PackRip: Cards is a **pack-opening simulator, not a card game**. There is no PvP, no decks, no duels, no trading, no real-money cash-out. The collection is the entire game loop.
- PackRip: Cards contains **no third-party trademarked TCG content**. All card art is original to PackRip, generated offline using AI tools from generic creature and ornamental-card prompts.
- Pull rates at launch: God Pack ~0.2%, Crystal ~1%, Shining ~2%, Gold Star ~2.8%, Rare Secret ~5%, Holo EX ~16.7%, Holo Rare ~28%. Foil variants roll independently per card at 1–5% by rarity. Pity guarantees fire after 20 packs without Holo Rare (up to 200 for Crystal). Numbers are server-tunable via Cloudflare Workers KV; the in-app Pull Rates sheet is authoritative.
- PackRip Plus is family-shareable; coin packs are not. Restore Purchases is wired up in Settings. Settings → About → Device ID exposes the anonymous UUID with tap-to-copy for support handoffs.
